Professional Summary

Seasoned Project Manager and Certified Scrum Master (6.5 years) with 14+ years of experience driving large-scale banking, lending, and regulatory compliance programs across global financial institutions. Proven expertise in managing end-to-end project delivery — from scope definition and sprint execution to go- live readiness, release governance, and hypercare support, with strong stakeholder communication.

Adept at leading Agile–Waterfall hybrid delivery models, integrating Project Tracking Systems (PTS) for milestone tracking, risk mitigation, and audit readiness. Skilled in managing cross-functional, onshore– offshore teams and coordinating with PMOs, vendors, and business stakeholders for seamless delivery.

Experienced in digital transformation initiatives focused on mobile banking, digital onboarding, and customer journey modernization, leveraging API-led integration, automation, and data governance frameworks to enhance customer experience and regulatory compliance. Strong exposure to service transition, including BAU handover, documentation, and end-user training to ensure smooth adoption.

Skill & Core Competencies:

Agile & Project Management:

Certified Scrum Master (CSM) & DASSM-certified Project Manager with proven expertise in end-to-end project delivery for banking, lending, and compliance programs.

Skilled in Agile–Waterfall hybrid delivery models ensuring on-time, quality-driven results across global teams.

Led end to end delivery of Digital customer Journey Transformation programs for loan origination and drove agile transformation by implementing Scrum and kanban frameworks enabling faster release cycles 25-30 % improvement in time to market

Strong in release governance, with hands-on expertise in all Scrum ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, Retrospectives, and Backlog Refinement.

Skilled in managing enterprise-level project tracking through PTS (Project Tracking System) for governance, milestone tracking, and delivery reporting.

Proven expertise in end-to-end project lifecycle management from initiation and planning to execution, monitoring, and closure.

Managed go-live readiness activities including release planning, cutover checklist, environment readiness, and stakeholder sign-offs.

Led hypercare support (post go-live) by tracking production issues, prioritizing fixes, and coordinating with development, testing, and business teams.

Owned handover from project delivery to Business-as-Usual (Service Management) including documentation, knowledge transfer, and support process alignment.

Conducted training and walkthrough sessions for business users and operations teams to ensure smooth adoption.

Experienced in regulatory, compliance, and system integration projects under tight delivery timelines with cross-regional stakeholder coordination.

• Strong ability to create and maintain project artifacts (charters, PTS dashboards, status reports, RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) logs, and CMP trackers) ensuring

transparency and audit readiness.

Set up governance frameworks with PMO for project status reporting, escalation management, and decision tracking.

Adept at maintaining audit-ready documentation and governance artifacts, ensuring transparency and regulatory compliance.

Managed end-to-end Change Request lifecycle, including impact analysis, documentation, approval workflows, and implementation under Citi’s PMO governance.

Worked with technical teams to estimate effort; define scope, timeline, and resource allocation

Adept at maintaining audit-ready documentation and governance artifacts, ensuring transparency and regulatory compliance.

Worked as JIRA Administrator for multiple Citi projects, configuring workflows, issue types, and user access to support Agile delivery.

Banking & Lending Domain Expertise:

Over 11.5 years of BFSI experience, delivering end-to-end banking, lending, and regulatory compliance programs for global institutions including Citibank.

Successfully led Citi projects such as Procure-to-Pay (P2P) modernization, FINRA compliance automation, and KSA RHQ entity onboarding, ensuring governance, audit readiness, and regulatory alignment across multiple regions.

Expertise in Loan Origination (LOS) and Loan Management Systems (LMS) — covering KYC, document verification, underwriting, sanctioning, disbursement, EMI scheduling, repayment, foreclosure, and NPA workflows.

Hands-on experience in digital lending products such as Loan Against Property (LAP), SME Loans, Business Loans, Consumer Durable Loans, and Emerging Enterprise Group (EEG) portfolios.

Strong knowledge of core banking systems — Finacle, TCS BANCS, Pennant, FINNONE Neo, and Welcom Financier — managing integrations, product enhancements, and module testing.

Proficient in payments & transaction processing (NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, SWIFT, NACH, BACS, ARUDD, ADDACS) and system automation for digital operations.

Deep understanding of regulatory & compliance frameworks — FINRA, CKYC, CIBIL/CRIF — ensuring transparency, data governance, and risk mitigation.

Adept at bridging functional, technical, and compliance delivery in complex financial ecosystems, enabling digital transformation under strict PMO and governance controls.

Tools & Technologies:

Project & Agile Tools: Jira, Confluence, Zephyr, TFS, Trello, MS Project, Visio

Testing & Quality Tools: Microsoft Test Manager, HP ALM



Integration & Collaboration Tools: DocuSign, Fieldglass, Nexis, ServiceNow

Technical & Functional Skills:

End-to-end delivery management of digital lending, banking, and compliance platforms, ensuring governance, quality, and timely go-live.

Strong understanding of system architecture, API integration, data flow design, and end-to- end functional testing for enterprise BFSI systems.

Experienced in preparing and reviewing business & functional requirement documents (BRD/FRD), impact assessments, and regression analysis.

Skilled in UAT planning, defect tracking, release management, and test evidence validation for audit compliance.

Hands-on experience in PTS, JIRA, Confluence, Zephyr, MS Project, and ServiceNow for project tracking, reporting, and documentation.

Proficient in coordinating system integration testing (SIT) and user acceptance testing (UAT) across onshore–offshore teams.

Adept at bridging functional and technical stakeholders, ensuring alignment between business needs, technology delivery, and compliance frameworks.

Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills ensuring audit readiness and traceability of all project deliverables.

Professional Experience

Virtusa Pvt Ltd – Pune | Client: Citibank (Global BFSI Projects)

Feb 2022 – Till Date

Project Portfolio:

Delivered three major Citi programs focused on regulatory compliance, cross-border governance, and financial system enablement — including KSA RHQ Entity Enablement, Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Modernization, and FINRA Compliance Automation ensuring governance, audit readiness, and regulatory alignment across multiple regions (KSA, China, Asia).

➢ KSA RHQ Entity Onboarding – Set up new legal entity and regulatory framework for Citi’s KSA

operations under MISA & CBAT compliance.

The KSA RHQ Entity Enablement Project was initiated under a Saudi regulatory directive requiring Citibank to establish a Regional Headquarters legal entity and secure a MISA license. The initiative complied with CBAT (Cross-Border Approval & Transparency) processes and involved enabling and validating critical financial systems — APS, FFS, PERL, GENESIS, P2P, and eRECON — ensuring seamless integration, data integrity, and operational independence of the new entity.

➢ FINRA Compliance Automation - Automated onboarding and review process for non-employee

compliance validation.

The FINRA Compliance Automation Project focused on automating compliance governance and onboarding processes for eligible non-employees across the Asia region. The project focused on implementing technology-driven solutions to automate the onboarding and compliance review process.

➢ Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Modernization – Modernized procurement and financial workflow for Citi

China entities.

The Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Modernization Project was executed as part of Citi’s global P2P program to expand procurement and finance operations in China. It involved the setup of two new legal entities, Citi Securities and Citi Futures Company, regulatory approvals, and system integration across Fullsuite, PEARL, and S2, including implementation of GL and FA modules. The project

adopted a dual-cycle testing strategy — pre– and post–regulatory approval — to ensure compliance, audit readiness, and localization of financial operations.

Roles & Responsibilities

Led end-to-end project lifecycle, covering initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closure across multiple Citi workstreams.

Defined project scope, milestones, budgets, and resource plans ensuring timely and cost- efficient delivery.

Oversaw PTS-based project tracking, milestone adherence, and RAID management (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies).

Collaborated with Citi PMO, Compliance, Legal, and Finance teams for regulatory approvals and governance reviews.

Managed UAT cycles, test evidence, and release documentation ensuring audit readiness and regulatory compliance.

Coordinated across onshore–offshore teams (India, Singapore, China, and KSA) for seamless execution and alignment.

Reported project status, risks, and dependencies to senior Citi stakeholders and leadership committees.

Facilitated all Scrum ceremonies — Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, and Retrospectives ensuring disciplined Agile delivery.

Partnered with Product Owners and Business Analysts to define, refine, and prioritize product backlogs.

Removed impediments, improved sprint flow, and maintained transparency between development, QA, and business teams.

Promoted cross-functional collaboration, accountability, and sprint goal ownership across distributed Agile teams.

Infosys (Client: US Healthcare)

Project Manager | Oct 2021 – Jan 2022

Led end-to-end delivery of healthcare API modernization initiatives, managing project timelines, resources, and stakeholder expectations.

Strengthened regression automation coverage → reduced release risks & improved velocity. • Worked closely with stakeholders to define deliverables, prioritize product backlogs, and ensure quality releases.

Growth Source Financial Technologies

Project Manager/ Scrum Master| Jan 2020 – May 2021

Led end-to-end delivery of LOS & LMS modules for digital lending products such as LAP and Business Loans.

Streamlined Agile processes, improving sprint velocity and release predictability across product teams.

Collaborated with NBFC stakeholders to align features with regulatory and business goals.

Scrum Master | Feb 2018 – Nov 2019

Managed Agile delivery and implementation across multiple Finacle modules — Loans, Payments, Deposits, Account Origination, and CRM — for DBS Bank’s India expansion. • Led project planning, sprint execution, and cross-functional coordination ensuring timely rollout

across 24 new branches.

Managed Agile ceremonies, stakeholder communication, and sprint execution across lending and payments modules. Monitored testing governance, and risk management to ensure quality and regulatory compliance.

QSG (Client: Welcom Digital)

Test Engineer → Acting Scrum Master | Mar 2013 – May 2017

Delivered Payday Loan product enhancements (Uniface Financier) for UK-based digital lending. • Experience in ARUDD, BACS, ADDACS workflows & full-cycle functional/ regression testing. • Executed Agile sprints for digital payday-loan platform and lending modules. • Handled test planning, functional & regression testing, and release coordination.

Professional Experience
Virtusa Pvt Ltd – Pune | Client: Citibank (Global BFSI Projects)
Feb 2022 – Till Date
Project Portfolio:
Delivered three major Citi programs focused on regulatory compliance, cross-border governance, and financial system enablement — including KSA RHQ Entity Enablement, Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Modernization, and FINRA Compliance Automation ensuring governance, audit readiness, and regulatory alignment across multiple regions (KSA, China, Asia).
➢ KSA RHQ Entity Onboarding – Set up new legal entity and regulatory framework for Citi’s KSA
operations under MISA & CBAT compliance.
The KSA RHQ Entity Enablement Project was initiated under a Saudi regulatory directive requiring Citibank to establish a Regional Headquarters legal entity and secure a MISA license. The initiative complied with CBAT (Cross-Border Approval & Transparency) processes and involved enabling and validating critical financial systems — APS, FFS, PERL, GENESIS, P2P, and eRECON — ensuring seamless integration, data integrity, and operational independence of the new entity.
➢ FINRA Compliance Automation - Automated onboarding and review process for non-employee
compliance validation.
The FINRA Compliance Automation Project focused on automating compliance governance and onboarding processes for eligible non-employees across the Asia region. The project focused on implementing technology-driven solutions to automate the onboarding and compliance review process.
➢ Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Modernization – Modernized procurement and financial workflow for Citi
China entities.
The Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Modernization Project was executed as part of Citi’s global P2P program to expand procurement and finance operations in China. It involved the setup of two new legal entities, Citi Securities and Citi Futures Company, regulatory approvals, and system integration across Fullsuite, PEARL, and S2, including implementation of GL and FA modules. The project
adopted a dual-cycle testing strategy — pre– and post–regulatory approval — to ensure compliance, audit readiness, and localization of financial operations.
Roles & Responsibilities
Led end-to-end project lifecycle, covering initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closure across multiple Citi workstreams.
Defined project scope, milestones, budgets, and resource plans ensuring timely and cost- efficient delivery.
Oversaw PTS-based project tracking, milestone adherence, and RAID management (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies).
Collaborated with Citi PMO, Compliance, Legal, and Finance teams for regulatory approvals and governance reviews.
Managed UAT cycles, test evidence, and release documentation ensuring audit readiness and regulatory compliance.
Coordinated across onshore–offshore teams (India, Singapore, China, and KSA) for seamless execution and alignment.
Reported project status, risks, and dependencies to senior Citi stakeholders and leadership committees.
Facilitated all Scrum ceremonies — Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, and Retrospectives ensuring disciplined Agile delivery.
Partnered with Product Owners and Business Analysts to define, refine, and prioritize product backlogs.
Removed impediments, improved sprint flow, and maintained transparency between development, QA, and business teams.
Promoted cross-functional collaboration, accountability, and sprint goal ownership across distributed Agile teams.

Project Manager | Oct 2021 – Jan 2022
Led end-to-end delivery of healthcare API modernization initiatives, managing project timelines, resources, and stakeholder expectations.
Strengthened regression automation coverage → reduced release risks & improved velocity. • Worked closely with stakeholders to define deliverables, prioritize product backlogs, and ensure quality releases.
Growth Source Financial Technologies
Project Manager/ Scrum Master| Jan 2020 – May 2021
Led end-to-end delivery of LOS & LMS modules for digital lending products such as LAP and Business Loans.
Streamlined Agile processes, improving sprint velocity and release predictability across product teams.
Collaborated with NBFC stakeholders to align features with regulatory and business goals.
Quality Kiosk – Pune (Client: DBS Bank India)
Scrum Master | Feb 2018 – Nov 2019
Managed Agile delivery and implementation across multiple Finacle modules — Loans, Payments, Deposits, Account Origination, and CRM — for DBS Bank’s India expansion. • Led project planning, sprint execution, and cross-functional coordination ensuring timely rollout
across 24 new branches.
Managed Agile ceremonies, stakeholder communication, and sprint execution across lending and payments modules. Monitored testing governance, and risk management to ensure quality and regulatory compliance.

Test Engineer → Acting Scrum Master | Mar 2013 – May 2017
Delivered Payday Loan product enhancements (Uniface Financier) for UK-based digital lending. • Experience in ARUDD, BACS, ADDACS workflows & full-cycle functional/ regression testing. • Executed Agile sprints for digital payday-loan platform and lending modules. • Handled test planning, functional & regression testing, and release coordination.
